nights.title: Jake Bugg -  Alamo - UK & European Tour
nights.name: Jake Bugg
nights.extract: Jake Edwin Charles Kennedy, known professionally as Jake Bugg, is an English singer-songwriter. His self-titled debut album, Jake Bugg, some of which was co-written with songwriter Iain Archer, was released in October 2012 and reached number one on the UK Albums Chart. His second album, Shangri La, was released in November 2013, and his third, largely self-produced album, On My One, in June 2016. His fourth album, Hearts That Strain, a largely acoustic effort produced by Dan Auerbach, was released in September 2017.

tr.who: Jake Edwin Charles Kennedy, Jake Bugg adıyla tanınan İngiliz bir şarkıcı ve söz yazarıdır. Kendi adını taşıyan ilk albümü Jake Bugg, ekim 2012'de yayımlandı ve UK Albums Chart'ta birinci sıraya ulaştı.
facts: İkinci albümü Shangri La, kasım 2013'te yayımlandı.
Dördüncü albümü Hearts That Strain, Dan Auerbach'ın prodüksiyonuyla hazırlanan büyük ölçüde akustik bir çalışma olarak eylül 2017'de yayımlandı.
